title: Walk 15: a refusal says what to do about it

steps.say: Walk 15: forge token refusals, an unknown SSH host key and a refused SSH login on testmaschine. Use your own GitHub token scoped to the project repositories, with Contents read and write. No Administration right is needed. Open the machine vault in its terminal if necessary. Choose Next here.

Open Forges, then GitHub, and choose Change. Connect it and enter your token only at the local porelo-host key set github.com terminal prompt. Check that no token field appears in the form and that the prompt does not echo it.
Filter for test-project and choose porelo-ai/porelo-test-project. Check that it offers work on the machine when you can push, even without Administration rights. No deploy-key request should run.

Choose Work on it on testmaschine. If git.token.github.com is absent, the interface opens a terminal on testmaschine running porelo vault put git.token.github.com. Paste your own token only at Porelo's prompt. After the terminal ends, the vault listing must confirm that entry by name before the project is followed over https.

Try an expired token through the local terminal prompt, then reconnect. Check that the forge refusal is visible and that no token appears in a form or in the refusal. Restore your working token through the same terminal. Legacy deploy keys are not managed from the interface.

To try an unknown SSH host, remove github.com from the test account's known_hosts in its terminal. Under Projects, in the ⋮ of “Without a project”, choose “Start work” and enter git@github.com:porelo-ai/porelo-test-1.git. Choose Claude Code and start it. This SSH address uses the person's SSH key.

Check that the start says the machine has never met github.com and shows the offered host keys, marking one that the forge publishes. Trust the published key and ask again. After work starts, leave its session and remove the work from its menu.

Try watching an account that accepts none of your SSH agent's keys. Choose Watch another machine, Raise the forward for me, and enter that account and address. Leave the socket field empty and try the connection.

Check that the refusal explains that the host accepted none of your agent's keys and names the account's authorized_keys as the place for your public key. Close the dialog with Cancel and report any difference.
